defect: The formatter template emits reader.Depth++ in place of options.Security.DepthStep(ref reader) (the generated FormatterTemplate.cs changes the same way), so generated array-format deserializers never check the maximum object graph depth.
why: DepthStep is what throws when nesting exceeds MaximumObjectGraphDepth; without it deeply nested untrusted input can exhaust the stack in generated formatters.
